predictions.quote: on Monday we are going to see a flurry of executive orders I think it will be in the neighborhood 100 executive orders
predictions.prediction: On Monday January 20, 2025 (inauguration day), President Trump will sign approximately 100 executive orders.

predictions.quote: number one secure the border and I believe that will start on January 20th it will start by ending Catch and Release so that when people are apprehended they are detained and they are sent back to where they came from
predictions.prediction: Starting January 20, 2025, the Trump administration will move to secure the border by ending "Catch and Release," detaining apprehended migrants and sending them back rather than releasing them.

predictions.quote: I think there is also a mandate to end the federal government's war on energy on Texas oil and gas um and that will lower prices at the gas pump at the grocery store... I expect pretty much all of those [over 90 Biden-era energy regulations] to be reversed
predictions.prediction: The Trump administration will reverse most of the roughly 90+ Biden-era energy regulations and executive orders, ending the "war on energy," which will lower gas and grocery prices.

predictions.quote: the 2017 Trump tax cuts are expiring this year we are going to extend them my hope is we make them bigger and Bolder
predictions.prediction: The 2017 Trump tax cuts, set to expire in 2025, will be extended by the new Trump administration and Congress.

predictions.quote: Pam Bondi is going to be terrific she is going to get confirmed easily I think right now every Trump cabinet nominee gets confirmed
predictions.prediction: Every one of Trump's cabinet nominees (as of this January 2025 interview) will ultimately be confirmed by the Senate.

predictions.quote: Rubio so Rubio will get 90 votes he could get north of 95 votes it will be a huge bipartisan vote for Rubio
predictions.prediction: Marco Rubio will be confirmed as Secretary of State with roughly 90-95+ Senate votes, a large bipartisan margin.

predictions.quote: my guess is I think of the committee the D's are going to vote no but I think Pam will hold every Republican and so I I think she gets through easily
predictions.prediction: Pam Bondi will be confirmed as Attorney General, holding every Republican vote while Democrats largely vote no.

predictions.quote: Bobby Senator I think he makes it through
predictions.prediction: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. will be confirmed by the Senate as HHS Secretary.

predictions.quote: I find it quite plausible that the greenlanders about 50,000 of them would say wait a second I get to be an American
predictions.prediction: If a referendum is held, a meaningful share of Greenland's roughly 50,000 residents would vote in favor of becoming part of the United States.

predictions.quote: is the final outcome of this that we get total control of the Panama Canal back probably not I think that is a high lift but in many ways I think Trump is negotiating on price and I could easily see an outcome where both Navy ships and commercial ships that are American pay much much lower rates number one and number two critically that we get China the hell out of the canal
predictions.prediction: The U.S. will not regain full control of the Panama Canal, but negotiations under Trump will result in lower transit rates for U.S. Navy and commercial ships and the removal of Chinese state-owned enterprise presence from the canal.
